snippet.title: Industry Giant 4.0 | 1.0 Release Trailer (EN)
snippet.description:
Industry Giant 4.0 – Version 1.0 is here!

The beloved business sim returns stronger than ever – with total freedom, new tools, and deeper gameplay!

Build your industrial empire, optimize production chains, and dominate the markets – your way.
Play now on Steam: https://bit.ly/42AX2bA

Follow Industry Giant on Social Media:

About Toplitz Productions

Named after the mystic “Toplitz Lake” which is situated in a dense mountain forest high up in the Alps, Toplitz Productions was founded with the aim of developing and publishing computer and video games “with heart and soul”.
For more information, visit toplitz-productions.com.
